klipy_command_description: Search and share GIFs from KLIPY. Example: /klipy congratulations
klipy_error_auth: Could not authenticate with the KLIPY API. Check the App configuration.
klipy_error_not_configured: The KLIPY App is not configured yet. Ask an administrator to set the API Key in the App settings.
klipy_error_rate_limit: The temporary KLIPY request limit was reached. Try again later.
klipy_error_unavailable: The GIF service is temporarily unavailable.
klipy_setting_api_key_description: Private key issued in the KLIPY Partner Panel (partner.klipy.com). It is stored only in this workspace and never appears in messages or logs.
klipy_setting_content_filter_description: Content safety level applied to search results.
klipy_setting_locale_description: Language used to interpret searches, as xx or xx_YY (ISO 639-1 plus optional ISO 3166-1 country). Examples: pt_BR, en_US, es.
klipy_setting_result_limit_description: How many GIFs to offer in the preview, from 8 to 10. Rocket.Chat never displays more than 10.
klipy_setting_show_attribution_link_desc: Turn the "Powered by KLIPY" attribution into a link to klipy.com. The attribution itself is always shown.
klipy_setting_show_title_description: Include the KLIPY title of the GIF in the posted message.
klipy_usage:
Type a term to search.

Example: `/klipy congratulations`
